content_fields.title: Consider adding plugins for stronger authentication protocols and stricter password complexity rules (MariaDB)
content_fields.description: Strengthen database authentication with plugins for stronger protocols and password complexity.
content_fields.guidance: The database should enforce password complexity, expiry and reuse restrictions through its authentication plugins, or delegate authentication to a central directory.
content_fields.found: The database uses a static password supplied through the compose environment; no complexity or expiry policy is applied.
content_fields.conclusion: Authentication plugins are installed and configured on the database server.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should enable password policy enforcement on the server.
